mapper.sql: id, source_key AS sourceKey, period, source_file AS sourceFile, source_sheet AS sourceSheet, source_row AS sourceRow, raw_warehouse AS rawWarehouse, platform, platform_scope AS platformScope, country, market_scope AS marketScope, warehouse, warehouse_country AS warehouseCountry, shop, local_sku AS localSku, platform_sku AS platformSku, product_name AS productName, category1, category2, category3, owner, original_owner AS originalOwner, purchase_price AS purchasePrice, freight_price AS freightPrice, quantity, cost, currency, quantity_basis AS quantityBasis, excluded, exclusion_reason AS exclusionReason, mapping_status AS mappingStatus, mapping_key AS mappingKey, age_buckets AS ageBuckets, remarks, quality, extra, imported_at AS importedAt
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT period FROM rpa_database.inventory_snapshot WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} ORDER BY period
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(excluded = 1), 0) AS excludedCount, MAX(imported_at) AS importedAt FROM rpa_database.inventory_snapshot WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey}

SELECT period FROM rpa_database.inventory_snapshot WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} AND excluded = 0 GROUP BY period HAVING COUNT(quantity) > 0 AND SUM(COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(extra, '$.quantityStatus')), '') = 'ERROR') = 0 ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT period, platform, platform_scope AS platformScope, country, market_scope AS marketScope, warehouse, shop, owner, category1, currency, quantity_basis AS quantityBasis, mapping_status AS mappingStatus, local_sku AS localSku, platform_sku AS platformSku, product_name AS productName, quantity, cost, quality, excluded FROM rpa_database.inventory_snapshot WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} AND excluded = 0 ORDER BY period, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpa_database.inventory_snapshot WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} AND period IN #{period}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rpa_database.inventory_snapshot WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} AND period IN #{period}
